release_title: Introducing Gemini 2.0: our new AI model for the agentic era

models.name: Gemini 2.0 Flash
models.variant: Experimental; first model of the Gemini 2.0 family
models.capability_summary: 发布文称其为面向智能体时代（agentic era）的 Gemini 2.0 家族首个模型。13 项评测横跨知识、代码、数学、多模态与长上下文，亮点为 Natural2Code 92.9% 与 MATH 89.7%。

models.name: Project Mariner
models.variant: research prototype built with Gemini 2.0 (browser agent)
models.capability_summary: 发布文将 Project Mariner 定位为基于 Gemini 2.0 构建的浏览器操作研究原型，能理解浏览器页面并代用户完成多步任务。本次发布为其报告的唯一数值是 WebVoyager 83.5%。

locator.heading: Project Mariner: agents that can help you accomplish complex tasks
locator.quote_snippet: Project Mariner achieved a state-of-the-art result of 83.5% working as a single agent setup

benchmark_evidence.notes: new-benchmark: webvoyager not yet in data/benchmarks/. Only prose-scoreable row on the page: the score belongs to Project Mariner (agent prototype built with Gemini 2.0), not to the Gemini 2.0 Flash model itself — model_id reflects that. The page text explicitly defines the benchmark as testing agent performance on end-to-end real world web tasks.

Companion posts the same day (Deep Research + 2.0 Flash Experimental in Gemini app, blog.google/products/gemini/google-gemini-deep-research/) add no benchmark numbers.
